message.content: {"label":"partially_sufficient","reason":"The retrieved Uber passages establish the existence and mechanism of the underwriters’ over-allotment option, but there is no explicit data on share limits, period, or seller of additional shares for DoorDash or Airbnb in the provided passages.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Uber: existence of underwriters' over-allotment option and who bears obligation to purchase additional shares when exercised","passage_rank":1,"quote":"To the extent the option is exercised, each underwriter will become obligated, subject to certain conditions, to purchase about the same percentage of the additional shares of common stock as the number listed next to the underwriter’s name in the preceding table bears to the total number of shares of common stock listed next to the names of all underwriters in the preceding table."},{"requirement":"Uber: mechanism that underwriters buy additional shares when the option is exercised (vs selling stockholders)","passage_rank":1,"quote":"These amounts are shown assuming both no exercise and full exercise of the underwriters’ over-allotment option."}],"missing_requirements":["DoorDash: whether greenshoe exists, share limit, exercise period, and who sells the additional shares","Airbnb: whether greenshoe exists, share limit, exercise period, and who sells the additional shares","Uber: exact share limit and exercise period (not provided in the passages)"],"concerns":["None beyond partial sufficiency due to missing details for DoorDash/Airbnb and Uber's exact limits/period absent in provided text."]}
